name: RecordEvent
description: A dated event — open day, info evening, trade fair: start and optional end, venue and address, registration link and price, plus its own page at /event/<slug> with a free content body.
when_to_use: Anything with a date the visitor might attend. One record per occurrence — a series is several records, because each needs its own date and registration.
capabilities: start/end datetimes with an all-day flag that hides the times
venue name plus street/zip/city for directions
registration link and a free-text price so 'kostenlos' works
content_elements: the event page's body — any active Content Block

ai.prompt_summary: Event record (tx_factorycore_record_event, type slug 'event'): title (required), slug (required, auto from title), excerpt (1-2 sentences for the card), start_date (required, ISO datetime — the sort key), end_date (empty for a single moment), all_day (0|1 — hides times), location_name, address_street/zip/city, registration_link, price (free text), hero_image (array of one file), content_elements (the body).
ai.content_guidelines: Title names the event, not the date ('Tag der offenen Tür', not 'Tag der offenen Tür am 14.6.'). Set all_day rather than inventing 00:00 times. Leave price empty rather than guessing.

field_hints.start_date: ISO 8601 with time (2026-06-14T17:00:00). Lists sort on it, and a past date usually means the event drops off the page.
field_hints.end_date: Only for events spanning hours or days. Empty is normal.
field_hints.all_day: Set to 1 when there is no meaningful time — the frontend then shows the date alone.
field_hints.price: Free text on purpose: 'kostenlos', 'ab 12 €' and '12 € / 8 € reduziert' are all valid.
